last.verdict: Beyond Meat's sales keep shrinking and Q4 is guided lower, but its gross margin hit a five-year high and cash burn eased.

takeaways.label: Sales still shrinking
takeaways.text: Revenue fell 8.1% to $64.5 million, and Q4 is guided to $54-59 million. U.S. retail volume dropped 20.8% on lost shelf space and weak category demand.

takeaways.label: Margins improved sharply
takeaways.text: Gross margin rose to 19.3% from 7.4% a year earlier, as cost per pound fell 10.1%. Adjusted EBITDA loss narrowed to $24.6 million from $33.5 million.

takeaways.label: Europe is the bright spot
takeaways.text: International retail sales rose 13.3% on strong European burger demand. International foodservice fell 19.4% as some fast-food burger customers cut orders.

takeaways.label: Balance sheet still strained
takeaways.text: Cash is $169.3 million against $313.9 million of debt, and $14.5 million of notes mature in March 2027. The $93.0 million operating loss included $57.1 million of write-downs.

history.verdict: Revenue beat, but a weak Q3 outlook and wider core losses sent shares down.

reasons.label: Weak Q3 outlook
reasons.text: Q3 revenue guided to $60-65 million, below Wall Street's roughly $65.6 million estimate.

reasons.label: Wider core loss
reasons.text: Adjusted EBITDA loss widened to $27.7 million from $24.7 million a year ago.

reasons.label: Falling U.S. sales
reasons.text: U.S. revenue fell 14.4% on weak category demand and fewer stores carrying products.
